主要内容: Medallion Financial Corp (the Company) entered into an amendment, dated August 11, 2016, by and among the Company, Medallion Funding LLC, Medallion Fine Art, Inc. and Sterling National Bank (the Amendment) to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement, dated March 28, 2011. Under the terms of the Amendment, (i) the maturity date of the facility was extended to June 30, 2018, (ii) the commitment amount of the facility was decreased from $22.135 million to $19.25 million, which is the current amount outstanding and (iii) other technical changes were implemented.
